name: @hobo/provider-upstash
description: HoBo Upstash temporary Redis provider: the data-only upstash.temporary-redis/v1 product definition (kv.redis-compatible/v1 native, therefore kv.key-value/v1 by refinement, and nothing queue or topic), a narrow versioned parser for the no-signup start-redis markdown response, an injected-transport driver that deposits the REST token into secret custody before it can reach a receipt, provider-reported expiry, and a console claim ceremony with a blocking post-claim token rotation.
